_comment: Manual archetype overrides. Keys are tickers (uppercase). Archetype IDs: 1=Banks 2=AssetManagers 3=Insurance 4=Exchanges 5=FinancialData 6=InvestmentBanks 7=Fintech 8=Other

BRK.B.reason: Conglomerate — diversified across railroads, utilities, manufacturing, insurance. No comparable pure play.

BRK.A.reason: Conglomerate — same as BRK.B (different share class).

SCHW.reason: Bank sweep deposits dominate economics (>50% of liabilities). Interest income > 50% of revenue. Classify as Banks despite broker-dealer SIC.

COIN.reason: Crypto exchange — volume-dependent capture rate, not a lending/payments fintech. Peers: CME, ICE (by business model).

V.reason: Pure payment network — no credit risk on books, revenue is network fees. Classify as Exchanges/Market Infrastructure.

MA.reason: Pure payment network — same as Visa. Peers: V, GPN, FIS, FISV.

MSCI.reason: Index and analytics provider with ARR economics. NOT peers with stock exchanges despite running indices.

SPGI.reason: Financial data, ratings, and analytics. Largest revenue segment is S&P Global Market Intelligence (data/analytics).

MCO.reason: Moody's — credit ratings and analytics. Financial data archetype despite 6211 SIC.

FDS.reason: FactSet — financial data and analytics platform.

MORN.reason: Morningstar — investment research, ratings, and data. ARR-driven economics.

ICE.reason: IntercontinentalExchange — exchange and data hybrid. Exchange economics dominant.

CME.reason: CME Group — derivatives exchange, volume-driven revenue.

CBOE.reason: Cboe Global Markets — options exchange, transaction fee model.

NDAQ.reason: Nasdaq Inc — exchange + data/analytics hybrid. Exchange archetype given dominant revenue share.

BLK.reason: BlackRock — pure asset manager by economics. AUM and fee rate are the primary value drivers.

BX.reason: Blackstone — alternative asset manager. Fee-related earnings and AUM are primary drivers.

APO.reason: Apollo Global — alternative asset manager, FRE-driven.

KKR.reason: KKR & Co — alternative asset manager, fee-related earnings model.

AFRM.reason: Affirm — BNPL/lending fintech. Take rate and credit loss are primary economics.

SQ.reason: Block (Square) — fintech platform combining payments and banking. Fintech, not pure exchange.

PYPL.reason: PayPal — fintech platform. Has significant credit exposure (BNPL). Fintech archetype.

GS.reason: Goldman Sachs — investment bank. Trading + advisory are dominant revenue segments.

MS.reason: Morgan Stanley — investment bank + wealth management hybrid. IB archetype given balance.

LAZ.reason: Lazard — pure advisory investment bank. No trading book.
